description: This file defines an 'AlertingClient' class that acts as an asynchronous HTTP client for interacting with an internal alerting service API. It includes methods to trigger alerts, list alerts, and acknowledge alerts, leveraging the 'httpx' library for async HTTP requests and handling exceptions related to misconfigurations and failed requests.

classes.name: AlertingClient
classes.description: Provides methods to interact asynchronously with the internal alerting service API, including triggering, listing, and acknowledging alerts.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the AlertingClient with an async HTTP client and default timeout.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client asynchronously.

methods.name: str _base(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the alerting service from settings, raising an exception if not configured.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] trigger(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a POST request to trigger (persist) an alert with the provided payload.

methods.name: list[Dict[str,Any]] list_alerts(self, params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Fetches a list of alerts, optionally filtered by parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ack_alert(self, alert_id: str)
methods.description: Acknowledges an alert given its ID.

ctags.name: ack_alert
ctags.pattern: /^    async def ack_alert(self, alert_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: list_alerts
ctags.pattern: /^    async def list_alerts(self, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> list[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: trigger
ctags.pattern: /^    async def trigger(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
